command_or_runner: verification.VerificationRunner -> org.junit.runner.JUnitCore.run(core.ReplayEquivalenceTest, core.BfsPathfinderTest, core.PositionTest, core.CheckpointTest, core.EngineSchedulingCheckpointTest, core.CheckpointFutureEquivalenceTest)

verification.name: core.ReplayEquivalenceTest
verification.invariant: live GameEngine.step() run vs. save-then-replay through the same GameEngine.step() entry point reach the same canonical final state

verification.name: core.CheckpointFutureEquivalenceTest
verification.invariant: prefix, checkpoint, RNG/move-count-advancing detour, restore, suffix reaches the identical canonical state as prefix, checkpoint, suffix run directly -- detects incomplete runtime-RNG or move-scheduling checkpoint restoration

verification.name: core.EngineSchedulingCheckpointTest
verification.invariant: restoring a checkpoint restores the exact move-scheduling counter it was taken at, not zero

verification.name: core.CheckpointTest
verification.invariant: defensive copy of the grid; collected-item interactable state and grid tile both restored; direction/invincibility/avatar-derivation restored exactly

verification.name: core.BfsPathfinderTest
verification.invariant: start==target, unreachable/blocked target, shortest-path correctness, no repeated tiles, deterministic reconstruction
